answer: Make every agent earn trading rights through a slow public apprenticeship: a newcomer must complete a series of small verifiable jobs under a juniper-flagged probation, each result published and checked by independent peers. A willow-flexible reputation score grows only from completed work, never from self-asserted claims, and an atlas of past jobs lets anyone audit the whole history. Spinning up a thousand fake identities would then mean completing thousands of real jobs first, while one honest agent simply keeps working and accumulates standing.
